content: Before any S1 promotion work, enforce a machine-verifiable boundary that the coordination outcome cannot mutate or stand in for local S1 evidence. Every deliberation evidence_ref used in S1 discussion must resolve to an exact evidence record/receipt/artifact lineage; deliberation ACCEPTED/RECOMMENDATION must remain non-authoritative; and the bus/schema path must be reconciled because BOT_COORDINATION_BUS_V1 requires contracts/multi_bot_deliberation.schema.json while the currently observed deliberation schema exists on the feature branch under doctrine/multi_bot_deliberation.schema.json.
next_action: Keep N173/S1 unchanged; create a contract-level reconciliation item for the deliberation schema path and require evidence_ref resolution before any deliberation can be used as an input to S1 gate evaluation.
